exact: migration in host through an epithelial cell layer
migration of symbiont within host by transepithelial trafficking
transepithelial migration of symbiont in host

definition: A process in which a symbiont moves from one side of an epithelium to the other within its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated migration across host transepithelium
